notes: PAUSED, BLOCKED and CANCELED require a recorded reason; a task moved to BLOCKED records its reason as blocked_reason. A task starts RUNNING only while the mission is IMPLEMENTING; VERIFYING needs every task VERIFYING or DONE, and REVIEWING and READY_PR need every task DONE. Holds: a hold (PAUSED or BLOCKED) ends only through resume with a resolution, or through accept-scope when every open blocker is the constitution-change block of the reconcile procedure. A clarification or criteria change on a held mission keeps the hold and its blockers, sets previous_state to PROPOSED and resets tasks and scope; accept-scope on any other hold accepts the scope, keeps the hold and sets previous_state to PLANNED. Resume is explicit reconciliation to the previous active state (or IMPLEMENTING for premerge repair), requires a resolution, runs the same checks as the forward transition into that state, and refuses tasks whose repair budget is still exhausted. Starting RUNNING again after the repair budget is exhausted moves the task and mission to BLOCKED; one material replan (task-update) resets the budget once. After a second exhaustion, add a replacement task during the premerge hold with task-add and "replaces": "<exhausted task id>" plus a reason: the exhausted task moves to task_history, dependents follow the replacement, and the mission stays high risk. resume --replan-models does not refund the paused attempt; the next RUNNING spends a new attempt. A constitution reconcile (block, exception decision bound to the new constitution hash, accept-scope) advances a product mission's base_commit to the newest commit carrying the current constitution whose changes since the base touch only protected factory controls, recorded in base_history; otherwise cancel and recreate the mission. READY_PR is local evidence only (constitution: Honest records); a failed remote CI result or a review requesting changes returns READY_PR to IMPLEMENTING, and MERGED requires a successful CI reference for the candidate commit plus an existing merge commit containing it. Local decision references are not authenticated approvals. Delivery states require enabled configuration and external evidence; an unhealthy observation leads to RECOVERING. No deployment command is executed by state transitions.
